title: Agent consumes runaway compute, tokens, network or budget
bad_event: Cumulative metered usage of some resource exceeds its cap, a rate window is exceeded, or work runs after expiry.
adversary: Model: any trace of issue/work (any resource vector)/tick/expire/halt; rollback excluded by legal.
refutation: A trace exceeding a per-resource cap or rate despite full checks (witnesses: aggregate-only cap, reported cost, rate burst, no expiry, rollback).
scope: Lean model only (see SC-28 for lineage and the cgroup CPU/pids evidence). Not: GPU/token metering in deployment.

assumptions.text: Operations carrying trusted identities (reviewer, approver, admin, user) are those principals' own acts (not modelled; REVIEW-PACKET finding 1).
The meter sees all consumption of every resource (see SC-28 run-1 for CPU/pids on one host).
